'''Snoruuks''' were mobile [[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]] found on the planet [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. They would group in rings consisting of five to thirty plants. They could be herded by tapping one of the mushrooms, which would cause the whole ring to move in the opposite direction. The fungi would search for food and moisture, only stopping to take root in the winter to ride out the bad weather.<ref name="AJ10" />
